We need to determine which criminal charge(s) apply based on facts. The case: civil judgment for loan repayment, execution, defendant refused to comply, was detained for 15 days (judicial detention) for refusing to execute judgment and not reporting assets. This is typical "拒不执行判决、裁定" (refusal to execute judgment). In earlier example, first Q: facts about refusing to execute judgment, answer: 拒不执行判决、裁定. So same charge.

Thus answer: [罪名]拒不执行判决、裁定<eoa>

Thus final answer.
